THE SHANGHAI EVENING POST, WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 30, 1929.

Amur-Danish Line

It is reported that Moller & Co.,
British shipping company, have
taken over the interests of the
Anglo-Danish Steamship Company
between Shanghai and Vladivostok
and will begin operating November
1. The ships will fly the British
flag instead of the Chinese flag,
it is stated, to avoid complications.
With the change of shipping
firms here are strong possibilities
of tea shipments to Russia being
resumed. It is reported that cer-
tain foreign firms have offered to
ship between 30,000 and 40,000
chests of tea to Moscow via Vladi-
vostok during November and De-
cember.
Since the outbreak of Sino-
Russian conflict many Chinese
ships, chartered by Soviet owned
Mercantile Fleet, have been seized
in Siberia. But after repeated de-
mands by the owners, the ships,
with the exception of two belong-
ing to the San Poh Steam Navi-
gation Company have been releas-
ed. The two ships, which were
plying between various Siberian
ports before hostilities started, will
be released as soon as arrangements
at Vladivostok is in order. They
will reach Shanghai in about ten
days' time.

《上海晚邮报》，1929年10月30日，星期三。

阿穆尔-丹麦航线

据报道，英国航运公司莫勒公司（Moller & Co.）
已接管英丹轮船公司（Anglo-Danish Steamship Company）
在上海与符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）之间的业务利益，
并将于11月1日开始运营。据称，为避免复杂情况，
这些船只将悬挂英国国旗而非中国国旗。
随着航运公司的变更，
对俄茶叶运输恢复的可能性很大。据报道，某些
外国公司已提议在11月和12月期间，
经符拉迪沃斯托克向莫斯科运送
30,000至40,000箱茶叶。

自中俄冲突爆发以来，许多由苏联拥有的
商船队租用的中国船只在西伯利亚被扣押。但在船主
反复要求下，除属于三北轮船公司（San Poh Steam Navigation Company）的两艘船只外，其余船只均已获释。这两艘在敌对行动开始前航行于西伯利亚各港口之间的船只，一旦符拉迪沃斯托克的安排妥当，也将获释。它们预计将在约十天内抵达上海。

Date October 22, 19 29

Subject (in full) Soviet Shipping Agency Transferred to Messrs Moller & Co.

Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by H. Owens A.B. (Pol)

With reference to the attached, inquiries show
that the Anglo-Danish Shipping Coy, 8 French Bund, who
have acted as shipping agents for the Soviet Mercantile
Fleet since December 1927, will transfer the agency on
November 1, 1929 to Moller & Co. The transfer according
to Mr. L. Justesen, manager of the Anglo-Danish Shipping
Coy, is due to the amount of trouble experienced with
the Customs and Chinese Authorities in handling vessels
of the Soviet Mercantile Fleet.

Most of Moller & Co.'s ships are at present in
the fish trade and plying in the Ohotsk Sea between
Kamchatka, Sahalin Island and Vladivostock. Others
ply between Vladivostock and Black Sea ports transporting
salt for use by the fisheries in Ohotsk.

The shipping trade between Shanghai and Vladivostock
is practically nil at present and the only known departure
for the last named port is the "Commandant Henri Riviere"
sailing on October 24, with a cargo of 3,000 tons of tea
from the former Centrosojus.

It is also reported that Moller & Co. have chartered
some vessels for service with the Soviet Mercantile Fleet
from local Chinese shipping companies.

制作人：D.S. Maklaevsky。转呈人：H. Owens A.B. (Pol)

关于附件内容，经查询显示，自1927年12月以来一直担任苏联商船队航运代理人的英丹航运公司（Anglo-Danish Shipping Coy，地址法租界外滩8号），将于1929年11月1日把代理权移交给莫勒公司。据英丹航运公司经理 L. Justesen 先生称，此次移交是由于在处理苏联商船队船只时，与海关及中国当局发生了大量麻烦。

目前，莫勒公司的大部分船只从事渔业贸易，在堪察加、萨哈林岛和符拉迪沃斯托克之间的鄂霍次克海航行。其他船只则在符拉迪沃斯托克和黑海港口之间航行，运输供鄂霍次克渔业使用的盐。

目前上海与符拉迪沃斯托克之间的航运贸易几乎为零，已知前往后者的唯一离港船只是“亨利·里维埃指挥官”号（"Commandant Henri Riviere"），该船将于10月24日启航，载有来自前中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）的3,000吨茶叶。

另有报道称，莫勒公司已从本地中国航运公司租用了一些船只，用于苏联商船队的服务。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Foreign Section Station,
REPORT
Date September 21, 1929

Subject (in full) S.S. "Nancy Moller" and "Minnie Moller."

（印：SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL）

Made by Temp. Cl. Ass't Cook. Forwarded by Tho Robertson

My informants, certain Customs officers who formerly
served at Amoy and have had personal experience watching
vessels engaged in drug-trafficking, confirm their assertions
regarding the port of Keelung being a distributing centre for
narcotics, which arrive there in tons.

For specific reasons they have requested me not to
disclose their names as they are still in the service of the
Chinese Government.

They again assert that a system exists between the
Customs authorities at Keelung and persons engaged in drug-
trafficking, whereby a vessel can clear for a port to which
it never intends to proceed. Vessels have been known to clear
from Keelung for Vladivostock with drugs and have never gone
to that port, but have been seen on the China coast at a time
when, according to schedule, they should have been a thousand
miles away. In a similar manner, steamers are also cleared
for Hongkong and never touch in at that port.

They further report that they have seen Japanese
vessels unload drugs at out-of-the-way places below Foochow
in the Haitan straits, at which other vessels never call.

They have personally chased such steamers and, in
one particular case, at least, 100 cases of drugs were thrown
overboard and were the cause of fights amongst the fishermen
for months.

（批：Afn）

One of my informants remarked that during the past
two years, not one seizure of arms, propaganda or opium has
been made in vessels arriving in this port from Vladivostock.

These articles, he remarks, are evidently being directed
to other places.

A/D. C. I.
John T. Moar
T. C. A.

外侨科分站，
报告
日期：1929年9月21日

主题（全称）“南希·莫勒”号（S.S. "Nancy Moller"）和“明妮·莫勒”号（"Minnie Moller"）。

（印：秘密且机密）

制作人：临时助理员 Cook。转呈人：Tho Robertson

我的线人，即几位曾在厦门服役并有监视从事毒品走私船只个人经验的海关官员，证实了他们关于基隆港作为毒品分销中心的说法，抵达那里的毒品以吨计。

出于特定原因，他们请求我不披露其姓名，因为他们仍在中国政府任职。

他们再次声称，基隆海关当局与从事毒品走私的人员之间存在一种体系，使得船只可以结关前往一个它根本无意前往的港口。众所周知，有些船只携带毒品从基隆结关前往符拉迪沃斯托克，却从未去过该港口，反而在按照时刻表本应远在千里之外的时候，被人发现出现在中国沿海。同样地，有些轮船结关前往香港，却从未在该港停靠。

他们还报告说，他们曾看到日本船只在福州下方海坛海峡中一些偏僻的地方卸载毒品，其他船只从不去那些地方。

他们曾亲自追逐此类轮船，且在至少一个特定案例中，有100箱毒品被抛入海中，导致渔民们为此争斗数月。

（批：Afn）

我的一位线人指出，在过去两年中，从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达本港的船只上，未查获过任何武器、宣传品或鸦片。

他指出，这些物品显然被运往其他地方。

A/D. C. I.
John T. Moar
T. C. A.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
August 22, 1929. G.P. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 444.
Date. 22. 8. 29.

S.S. "Nancy Moller" and "Minnie Moller."

Certain local Customs officials, consular employees and
various shipping concerns, who have been approached privately
on the matter of the Moller steamers, unanimously report that
for some long time these steamers have been suspected of being
engaged in the opium and narcotics traffic.

The movements of the s.s. "Nancy Moller" and "Minnie Moller"
serve to prove the suspicion. They were not however under charter
to the Soviet Mercantile Fleet at the dates given in the attached
letter of H.B.M. consulate.

Keelung is known to be the distributing centre for all manner
of narcotics such as opium, morphia, cocaine, etc., which are
received into this port in tons.

There exists a kind of understanding between the Japanese
Customs and certain shipping concerns, which call at Keelung,
purchase the drugs and dispose of them at places along the
China coast.

It is customary for a steamer to put in at Keelung obtain the
drugs without even loading or unloading cargo, then clear for
Hongkong, where the same performance is repeated, and some ten
days later call in at Amoy and dispose of the drugs.

The Moller Company never employ engineers, mate or captain
who are members of the Engineers or China coast officers guilds,
but pick up nondescript individuals who serve on the understanding
that they may "supplement" their salary.

The s.s. "Kwangfoh" was fitted up with cabins and captain
Warrild was allowed a free hand as to their disposal to supplement
his salary. In November 1927, Capt. F.A.Benz, employed by Moller
& Co. held up the s.s. "Saitan" chartered by Moller & Co. in lieu
of his- Benz's claim against Tsang Yin- the owner.

It appears to be generally understood that the capital of
Messrs Moller & Co. is chiefly Chinese and put up by that
company's compradores.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
1929年8月22日。总注册处
编号：I. O. D. 444。
日期：29年8月22日。

“南希·莫勒”号（Nancy Moller）和“明妮·莫勒”号（Minnie Moller）轮船。

某些当地海关官员、领事馆雇员以及各家航运公司，就莫勒轮船一事被私下征询意见时，一致报告称，长期以来这些轮船一直涉嫌从事鸦片和麻醉品贸易。

“南希·莫勒”号和“明妮·莫勒”号的行踪证实了这一嫌疑。然而，在英国驻华领事馆附函中所述的日期，它们并未被苏联商船队租用。

众所周知，基隆是各类麻醉品（如鸦片、吗啡、可卡因等）的分销中心，这些毒品以吨计进入该港口。

日本海关与某些停靠基隆的航运公司之间存在某种默契，这些公司购买毒品并在中国沿海各地进行处置。

通常的做法是，轮船停靠基隆获取毒品，甚至无需装卸货物，然后结关前往香港，在那里重复同样的操作，约十天后停靠厦门并处置毒品。

莫勒公司从不雇佣属于工程师公会或中国沿海船员公会的工程师、大副或船长，而是招募一些身份不明的人，这些人受雇的前提是他们可以“补贴”其薪水。

“广福”号（Kwangfoh）轮船配备了客舱，瓦里尔德（Warrild）船长被允许自由处置这些客舱以补贴其薪水。1927年11月，受雇于莫勒公司的F.A.本茨（F.A.Benz）船长扣留了由莫勒公司租用的“赛坦”号（Saitan）轮船，以抵偿本茨对该船船主曾寅（Tsang Yin，音译）的索赔。

据普遍了解，莫勒公司（Messrs Moller & Co.）的资本主要来自中国，并由该公司的买办提供。

pages.en:
===== ( 2 ) =====

Eric Moller, the manager of the Moller Company, is a British
subject. He has two brothers one of whom is alleged to be a
Norwegian and the other a German. His father- Nils Moller, was
a Swede. It is reported on very reliable authority that Eric
Moller senior maintains a Russian paramour for whom he fitted.
out the premises at 410 Avenue Joffre as a boarding house and
pays her a very substantial monthly sum of money.
pages.zh:
===== ( 2 ) =====

莫勒公司经理埃里克·莫勒（Eric Moller）是英国臣民。他有两个兄弟，据称一个是挪威人，另一个是德国人。他的父亲——尼尔斯·莫勒（Nils Moller），是瑞典人。据非常可靠的消息来源报告，老埃里克·莫勒包养了一名俄罗斯情妇，他为她在霞飞路410号布置了一处寓所作为寄宿公寓，并每月支付给她一大笔钱。

D.441

August 22 29.

Confidential.

My dear Jamieson,

With reference to your letter of August 10 on
the subject of the somewhat mysterious movements of the
s.s. "Nancy Moller" and "Minnie Moller", I forward herewith
a police report on the subject, together with our complete
file which may be of interest to you. You will notice
that one of Eric Moller's ships was in trouble early in
1924 over a shipment of heroin, no doubt you have records
of this incident at the Consulate. Kindly return file in
due course.

Yours sincerely,

(Sgd) D. J. Martin.

E. G. Jamieson, Esq., C.B.E.,
H. B. M. Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI.

LcH
pages.zh:
D.441

1929年8月22日。

机密。

亲爱的詹姆森：

关于你8月10日来信提及“南希·莫勒”号和“明妮·莫勒”号轮船 somewhat mysterious（有些神秘）的行踪一事，现随函附上一份关于此事的警方报告，以及我们的完整档案，或许你会感兴趣。你会注意到，埃里克·莫勒旗下的一艘轮船在1924年初曾因一批海洛因运输而陷入麻烦，想必领事馆存有此事的记录。请在适当时候归还档案。

此致，

（签名）D. J. 马丁。

E. G. 詹姆森先生，C.B.E.勋衔，
大英帝国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

LcH

据普遍了解，莫勒公司（Messrs Moller & Co.）的资本主要来自中国，并由该公司的买办提供。
莫勒公司经理埃里克·莫勒（Eric Moller）是英国臣民。他有两个兄弟，据称一个是挪威人，另一个是德国人。他的父亲——尼尔斯·莫勒（Nils Möller），（已故）是瑞典人。据非常可靠的消息来源报告，老埃里克·莫勒包养了一名俄罗斯情妇，他为她在霞飞路410号布置了一处寓所作为寄宿公寓，并每月支付给她一大笔钱。

SHANGHAI.
P.O. Box 259.

10th August, 1929.

My dear Martin,

We have received a despatch from our
Consul at Tamsui in Formosa reporting on
somewhat mysterious movements on the part
of the s.s. "Nancy Moller" and "Minnie
Moller" which as you know are owned by
Eric Moller here. These ships visited
Keelung in January and March for no osten-
sible purpose, i.e., they neither loaded
or discharged cargo and the suggestion is
that they may have been engaged in smug-
gling opium.

Can you tell me whether either of
these ships has ever been suspected of
/being

Captain R.M.J.Martin,

Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JULY 25, 1929.
（批：9988 26/7.29）

ANOTHER ROUTE AVAILABLE FOR
PASSENGERS TO EUROPE

The severance of relations between China and Russia has
caused no little inconvenience to a number of people in Shang-
hai who had planned to make the trip to Europe via Siberia.
We were advised yesterday however, of a route available to
Europe, and generally known, by Mr. H. I. Jansson of the
Anglo-Danish Shipping Co., who states that the s.s. [ obscured ]
[ obscured ], 5,000 tons will be dispatched for Vladivostok on the
[ obscured ] August. A few first-class accommodations are available
for passengers who contemplate going to Europe via the
Ussuriiski Amur Railway. There is one weekly express, every
Monday, from Vladivostok to Moscow via the Ussuriiski Amur
Railway and the passage is only one day longer than via the
C.E.R. There is also another train, a couple of days slower,
which leaves Vladivostok every day except Monday. On the
express, there is no change of car between Harbin and
Moscow.

（批：JL.）

前往欧洲的乘客另有路线可选

中俄断交给上海一些计划经西伯利亚前往欧洲的人造成了不少不便。然而，昨天我们得知有一条通往欧洲的路线，这是由英丹航运公司的H. I. 詹森先生告知的，他声明[模糊不清]号轮船，5,000吨，将于[模糊不清]月 dispatch（派遣）前往符拉迪沃斯托克。少量头等舱位可供那些考虑经乌苏里江-阿穆尔铁路前往欧洲的乘客预订。每周一有一班快车从符拉迪沃斯托克经乌苏里江-阿穆尔铁路开往莫斯科，行程仅比经中东铁路多一天。还有另一班列车，速度慢两天，除周一外每天从符拉迪沃斯托克发车。乘坐快车，在哈尔滨和莫斯科之间无需换车。
